# awscc_wellarchitected_agent_organizational_profile (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentOrganizationalProfile. An Agent Organizational Profile is an Agent Profile scoped to an AWS Organization; the organization is inferred from the caller's identity, and the profile does not carry a single-account execution role or aggregation configuration. Only usable in the AWS Organizations management or delegated-admin account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the organizational profile. Unique within the account and used as the last component of the ARN.
- `pillars` (Set of String) The list of Well-Architected pillars to focus on.

### Optional

- `business_overview` (String) A business overview for the organizational profile used to improve recommendation quality.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Whether deletion protection is enabled for the organizational profile. When enabled, the profile cannot be deleted until deletion protection is disabled.
- `description` (String) A description of the organizational profile.
- `display_name` (String) The human-readable display name of the organizational profile.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Key-value pairs to associate with the Agent Organizational Profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Organizational Profile.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the organizational profile was created.
- `created_by` (String) The identifier of the system or user that created this organizational profile.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_at` (String) The timestamp when the organizational profile was last modified.
- `last_modified_by` (String) The identifier of the system or user that last modified this organizational profile.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wellarchitected_agent_organizational_profile.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Organizational Profile

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wellarchitected_agent_organizational_profile.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_wellarchitected_agent_organizational_profile.example "arn"
```
